deployments_detail.use: Generative AI Group: doc search/creation for medical writing (with Hitachi); AI high-speed drug discovery model; TalkLab KIBIT cognitive assessment (with FRONTEO)

AI Statistical Programming System (AI-SAS): AI that semi-automatically generates the SAS statistical analysis programs required for clinical trials, built on SAS Viya with machine/deep learning (CNNs). Deployed Sept 2023; also being adopted by other Japanese pharma companies and CROs. [SAS (SAS Viya)]
deployments_detail.value: Analysis time per trial cut ~100 hours (30% reduction, from ~350 hours); 30% reduction in standard work hours

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI application to draft clinical-trial regulatory documents (study protocol and Clinical Study Report/CSR), built on Amazon Bedrock with Claude 3.5 Sonnet in an isolated AWS environment; presented at AWS Summit as a validated PoC moving toward production. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)]

Generative AI solution for drug-development regulatory document creation (extracts key info from JP/EN trial data to draft documents). Technology developed by Shionogi, licensed to and launched by Hitachi for pharma/healthcare firms in Japan. [Hitachi]
deployments_detail.value: ~50% reduction in clinical study report creation time; ~20% reduction for trial protocol creation

deployments_detail.use: Drug target discovery collaboration using InveniAI's AlphaMeld machine-learning platform to identify drug targets and target combinations for psycho-neurological disorders; a compound selected via the platform reached Phase III. [InveniAI (AlphaMeld)]

Strategic research collaboration applying NEC OncoImmunity's machine-learning software to predict/identify optimal neoantigen targets for developing a novel hepatitis B therapeutic vaccine. [NEC (NEC OncoImmunity)]
